cases.title: COPY of pit P3 makes one new pit numbered P8 with its own PIT LABEL, says Check levels, keeps P3's own label, and one U takes the copy away
cases.expected: Select pit P3 (109D56) and COPY it by 0,-5000 (Enter ends COPY): the command line says '1 pit copied and numbered as new. Check levels: they came across from the originals (the Inspector shows which ones to confirm).'; exactly one new PIT BLOCK and one new PIT LABEL are added and the new label reads P8; one U echoes COPY and the object count returns to its value before the COPY; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: CE reacts to a real native COPY and renumbers the clone in the live drawing.
not_automated: The Inspector's Check levels mark is a picture item (Codex).
A COPY that takes pipes with the pit ('1 pit and N pipes copied ...') is not driven.
